Real mapping and clean PDFs processed th.detail: Real Chromium (Playwright 1.57.0) drives the adapter over loopback HTTP against real T05 fixture bytes fetched as Uint8Array. F01: mapping-amount.pdf opens via getDocument({data: <adapter-owned copy>}) with the caller-supplied digest verified before open; extraction emits '$1,000' while the rendered raster is byte-identical to mapping-control.pdf's raster (painted '$100') — looks right, reads wrong, end to end. F02: covered-amount.pdf emits both '$1,000' and '$100' raw items while its dark-pixel count matches covered-control.pdf within 8px, proving the hidden layer is reported, not painted away. All four F07 files and all four F08 files process the same path. Test: 'F01 mapping vs control: bytes in, raw text out, identical raster', 'F02 covered vs control: hidden layer kept raw, raster unaffected'. Counts: 10/10.

raw text not injected.detail: Each test re-opens the same bytes with a direct getTextContent({disableNormalization:true, includeMarkedContent:true}) on the same pinned build and asserts occurrences.map(raw_text) deep-equals the raw item string sequence — no injection, reordering or adapter-side normalization of raw_text; ordinals deep-equal the 0-based TextItem indices; normalized_text/normalization_map recomputed with contracts.normalize() per occurrence (normOk). Marked-content records counted, never emitted. Test: F01/F02 suites.

occurrence geometry/rotation/UserUnit ve.detail: F07: rotation 0/90/180/270 read as page.rotation; effective_view_box [20,40,500,390] (nonzero+negative CropBox origin), canonical C matrix asserted element-equal to the COORDINATES.md analytic value [2,0,0,-2,-40,780] (u=2, 960x700pt); pdf.js getViewport({scale:1}).transform equals @inkflip/geometry pageToDisplay (R*C) within 1e-6 on every page — viewportVerified true. Every emitted occurrence polygon is recomputed in-test from the raw TextItem (transform, width, ascent/descent) through the page's canonical C and compared elementwise — geometryMismatches 0 on all five F07 pages. Raster dims match rotated display size ([960,700] or [700,960]). F08: user_unit 0.5/1/2/10 reported exactly; canonical size is 520u x 400u pt; the 100pt fiducial square's right edge lands at 472u*scale px in the raster (no double scaling); u=10 hits the 4Mpx cap and the downsampling is recorded in raster.limitations. media_box/crop_box asserted null (unavailable through the selected API — never invented). Tests: 'F07 rotations and origins...', 'F08 UserUnit values...'.

no full glyph-paint provenance claim.detail: Every occurrence asserts geometry.precision in {estimated, page_only} and its limitations carry 'not a glyph-paint or per-character provenance'; multi-character items add the no-per-character-advance limitation. describe() reader/manifest records state the estimated-extent limitation; the serialized identity blob is asserted free of any exact-glyph/per-glyph claim. getOperatorList is never called as a visibility oracle.

render cancellation releases task/canvas.detail: A pre-aborted signal driven into renderPage exercises RenderTask.cancel() on a REAL in-flight pdf.js RenderTask (RenderingCancelledException path): the thrown ReaderError is failure=cancelled/user_cancel and every adapter-created canvas is asserted 0x0 afterwards; a subsequent render of the same page completes at full size (960x700) proving no half-alive task/canvas. Adapter-level extract with a pre-aborted signal returns status cancelled/user_cancel without touching the page. Text mid-walk cancel (chunkOccurrences=1, abort inside emitChunk) returns status cancelled with produced=retained=1 — produced evidence survives cancellation. Tests: 'render cancellation releases task and canvas; later renders unaffected', 'text extraction mid-walk cancel retains produced evidence'.

unavailable structure check is unsupport.detail: Checks planned for structure, ocr, object_render_mode, paint_overlap, crop_metadata and alignment all terminate status 'unsupported' with reasons matching /^unsupported:/ and produced_occurrence_count 0 — named reasons, never faked success. describe() marks the same capabilities 'unavailable' in both reader records. Test: 'unavailable capabilities terminate unsupported with named reasons'.

limitations: F10 (mapping-missing) and F11 (duplicates) have no generated fixtures in the T05 tree; the suite asserts their absence honestly and covers the substitute mechanism (ordinal-keyed occurrence identity preserves equal strings at distinct positions). No fixture or result was fabricated.
Original MediaBox/CropBox are unavailable through the selected pdf.js API: page.media_box/crop_box are null and page.view is recorded as the effective view only (limitation on every page record).
Occurrence extent is an estimated TextItem quad (transform + width/height + font ascent/descent); there is no occurrence-level visibility, render-mode or paint-overlap oracle on this boundary.
reading_order capability is 'approximate': the raw emitted getTextContent sequence only, not verified logical/screen-reader order.

Render rasters are bounded by pixel/edge caps; userunit-10 clamps scale and records it. Annotation rendering uses static appearance streams only (AnnotationMode.ENABLE); actions, links, forms, XFA, attachments and scripting are never activated.

The adapter does not stage the pdf.js main/worker pair: T02 staged the data assets (cmaps/standard_fonts/wasm/iccs) while the pinned pair is the frozen bun.lock install (pdfjs-dist@6.3.289, package integrity recorded in resolved-assets.json). The caller injects module + same-origin workerSrc; the suite serves both from the pinned install and records their sha256.
